title: COMP-3 sign nibble F treated as negative
business_cause: Unsigned amounts are decoded with the wrong sign, reversing credits and debits.
probable_cause: Faulty Java treats sign nibble F as negative or rejects it.
technical_cause: Faulty Java treats sign nibble F as negative or rejects it.
business_fix: Decode packed decimal sign nibbles the same way the COBOL program does: C and F are positive, D is negative.
fix_sentence: Read sign nibble F as positive (C and F positive, D negative), as the GnuCOBOL reference does.
